title: Desktop Folder Settings has no "revert" or "reset to default" buttons
line: Widget and desktop settings windows now have Defaults and Reset buttons, like System Settings.
explanation: The settings window shared by all widgets and the desktop (AppletConfiguration.qml) only had OK, Apply and Cancel, so the only way to undo edits was to cancel the whole dialog, and there was no way to go back to default values. The widget configuration already carries each key's default (as <key>Default), but nothing used it. The change adds Defaults and Reset buttons on the left of the footer: Reset reloads the current page from the saved settings, Defaults reloads it with the KConfig defaults (and is disabled when the page already shows them); the Wallpaper page handles both for the wallpaper plugin's own settings.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: add Defaults and Reset buttons to widget settings

Widget and desktop settings only had OK, Apply and Cancel, so there was
no way to undo edits or go back to defaults short of closing the dialog.
Add Defaults and Reset buttons like the ones in System Settings.

BUG: 482702

media.caption: Desktop Folder Settings, Icons page with two edits: only OK, Apply and Cancel
Same edits with the fix: Defaults and Reset buttons on the left
Wallpaper page before: no Defaults or Reset
Wallpaper page after: Positioning set to Centered, then Defaults brings it back to Scaled and cropped
Icons page after Reset: both edits undone, Reset and Apply disabled again
Icons page after Defaults: Sort by goes back to its default (Name) and Defaults turns disabled
Works for any widget: Digital Clock settings after Defaults (Show seconds back to Only in the tooltip)
